newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds higher as FOMC decision eyed.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds higher as FOMC decision eyed.

text.p: 1705 GMT - Austrian bonds rose on Tuesday as investors awaited outcome of key FOMC meeting and widely expected announcement of first U.S. interest rate rise in two years.
"It's all quiet and relaxed in expectation of the FOMC decision," said one trader. "Nobody really wanted to take on large positions."
Market participants saw good demand for shorter maturities, while noting some pressure at the longer end.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 35 bps at 98.65 to yield 5.81 pct (5.85) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.74/82 to yield 5.79/78.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed up 10 bps at 98.05 in bourse trade to yield 4.76 pct (4.78), quoted post-market at 98.10/98.18 to yield 4.75/73 percent.
* AGB future up 32 bps at 107.64 on turnover of 308 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany steady at minus six bps, five-year spread down eight at five bps.
* Money market rates higher with three-month VIBOR at 3.4 and overnight money at 3.16/3.41.
